name: Bloodmage: Eternal Curse casts Tank Stance Aura (#4885, #5551)
contract: Eternal Curse 800157 description: "...reducing your damage dealt by $807736s1% and increasing your threat generated by $807736s2%, plus an additional $807736s3% from damage dealt by spells that cost health." 807736 Tank Stance Aura has effect 0 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE BasePoints -11 (DieSides 1 -> -10), effect 1 SPELL_AURA_MOD_THREAT BasePoints 94 (DieSides 1 -> 95, not the 79/80 originally assumed here), effect 2 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER BasePoints 49 (-> 50) - all read from Spell.dbc. bloodmage_talent_events::OnAuraApply only cast SPELL_ETERNAL_CURSE_ARMOR (804320) on Eternal Curse, never 807736, so the tank stance never applied.

steps.label: No Tank Stance before Eternal Curse
Tank Stance Aura applies with Eternal Curse
Armor helper still applies alongside it
Tank Stance Aura is removed with Eternal Curse
